posts.title: Who's Paying for Your Apples?
posts.description: The podcasting ecosystem is a lot like a massive apple orchard in the Fall. Tons of apples, ripe and ready for harvesting and to be used in a variety of ways. As a consumer of apples, I can look at them and enjoy them all I want, but as soon as I pick one, I've got to pay for it. I can't just walk out of the orchard with a bag full of someone else's crop. The farmer wants to be compensated…

posts.title: Staying Afloat in the Rising Sea of AI Content
posts.description: The ocean waves are constantly in motion, sometimes roaring and crashing, other times gurgling softly. Even in chaos, there’s an underlying stability to the cycle. People reshape the sand every day–building sandcastles, digging holes, leaving their marks behind. Just as reliably, the tide wipes the sandy slate clean. The only way to preserve a sandcastle is to build far enough away from the water.
